title: Domain BeamElement primitive

supportingSourceFiles.coverage: Root BeamElement export is re-exported from the migrated implementation

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript BeamElement modules, including StructuralElement inheritance isolation, root re-export identity, exact JSON serialization, length, mutation/chaining, defaults, Unicode values and constructor errors.

tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The strict TypeScript declarations describe the existing JavaScript BeamElement contract without adding runtime behavior.
BeamSystem and FEM element implementations remain outside this slice.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic beam element node membership, releases, local-axis metadata, delegated length and serialization primitive only.
